items.title: Jillean Williams interviewed by Milt Fillius and Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 20, 1995
items.q: We were already familiar with Joe and the band of course and Sarah. ... we went to see George Shearing ... and then we went on the Waldorf Astoria, where the Count Basie Orchestra was playing with Sarah Vaughan and Joe Williams.

ctx.x: This is part of the preparation for the Jazz Archive at Hamilton College, which will deal primarily with the days of the Basie band and the life of Joe Williams. We are pleased to have with us today Jillean Williams, who is the wife of Joe, and who has been part of the scene with the Basie band and with Joe for many years. I’d like to ask you if you would tell us how you first met Joe and how the romance developed into a marriage.

Well there’s an old saying that comedians use that they met in a revolving door and they’ve been going ‘round together ever since. But in our case it’s actually true. Of course I was working in New York City and some English friends came to town and wanted to celebrate because they were on their way to the U.K. And so we went out for the evening and we went to see George Shearing, who was at The Embers in those days, and then we went on the Waldorf Astoria, where the Count Basie Orchestra was playing with Sarah…
